Container.Name: yt2abs
Container.Overview: YouTube audio to Audiobookshelf as podcast episodes. The container downloads audio via yt-dlp, sends it to the ABS library and deletes episodes after the retention period. The :latest image is the stable release. Before the first start, create /mnt/user/appdata/yt2abs/config.yaml based on config.example.yaml from the repository.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: HTTP port on the host. LAN-only service with no authentication - do not publish it on a public address.

Config.Name: Config dir
Config.Description: App directory: config.yaml, SQLite database, yt-dlp binary. Owner 99:100.

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: The same host directory that Audiobookshelf mounts as the podcast library.

Config.Name: Temp downloads
Config.Description: Temporary directory. Best on the same filesystem as the library (fast rename).

Config.Name: ABS_URL
Config.Description: Audiobookshelf address as seen from the yt2abs container.

Config.Name: ABS_API_KEY
Config.Description: Audiobookshelf API key (Settings - API Keys).

Config.Name: ABS_LIBRARY_ID
Config.Description: Podcast library ID in ABS (GET /api/libraries).

Config.Name: ABS_LIBRARY_PATH
Config.Description: Library path as seen by ABS and by this container. Do not change without changing the mount.

Config.Name: Library dir (yt2abs)
Config.Description: Library path inside the container. Must match the Library mount.

Config.Name: Temp dir (yt2abs)
Config.Description: Temporary directory path inside the container.

Config.Name: Data dir (yt2abs)
Config.Description: SQLite, bin/ for yt-dlp. Must be inside the mounted /config.

Config.Name: Config file (yt2abs)
Config.Description: config.yaml path. The file must exist before start.

Config.Name: yt-dlp bin dir
Config.Description: Install location of the updated yt-dlp. Must be inside the mounted /config, otherwise the update is lost on restart.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Public HTTPS address of the reverse proxy, e.g. https://yt2abs.example.com (bookmarklet links).

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: 1 = honour X-Forwarded-For only from YT2ABS_TRUSTED_PROXIES addresses.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Exact reverse proxy address in CIDR, e.g. 10.1.2.1/32. Separate several with commas.

Config.Name: API rate limit
Config.Description: API request limit per minute per client IP. 0 = no limit.

Config.Name: Public rate limit
Config.Description: /add request limit per minute per client IP.

Config.Name: Retention interval
Config.Description: How often to run the retention pass, in minutes.

Config.Name: Playlist enabled
Config.Description: Playlist polling kill-switch: 0 disables, empty = config.yaml decides.

Config.Name: yt-dlp update
Config.Description: 1 = automatic yt-dlp update from PyPI.

Config.Name: yt-dlp update interval
Config.Description: How often to check for yt-dlp updates, in hours.

Config.Name: Discord webhook
Config.Description: Full Discord webhook URL. Empty = disabled.

Config.Name: Discord username
Config.Description: Optional Discord notification sender name.

Config.Name: Discord events
Config.Description: Discord events: imported,retry,failed | all | none.

Config.Name: Notifications disabled
Config.Description: 1 = disables all notification channels.

Config.Name: ntfy topic
Config.Description: ntfy topic. Empty = channel disabled.

Config.Name: ntfy URL
Config.Description: ntfy server address (root only).

Config.Name: ntfy token
Config.Description: Bearer token for the protected ntfy topic.

Config.Name: ntfy events
Config.Description: ntfy events: failed,deleted | all | none.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Container timezone.
